entities.summary: Sokari Douglas Camp (b. 1958, Buguma) was a musician or composer of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Buguma and Nigeria. Known in the fields of nigeria, painters & sculptors, africa.
